description: This Java source file defines the ProductReview entity class for the e-commerce application. It models customer reviews of products, including properties like rating, review date, status, and associations to Customer and Product entities. The class is annotated for ORM with JPA, supporting persistence and database interactions. It also includes audit capabilities via embedded AuditSection and entity listener.

classes.name: ProductReview
classes.description: Entity class representing customer reviews of products, including ratings, review date, status, and associations to customer and product entities. Implements auditing features and persistence annotations for ORM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product review.

methods.name: getReviewRating

methods.name: getReviewRead
methods.description: Returns the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: setReviewRead
methods.description: Sets the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the review.

methods.name: setStatus

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer who authored the review.

methods.name: setCustomer

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product associated with the review.

methods.name: setProduct
